name: AIDS Watashi o Aishite... Jin'ai Seijin
original_name: ＡＩＤＳ私を愛して・・・神愛聖人
source:
Main hero is an ordinary salary-man of 25 years old. He has a girlfriend, but they have not spent much time together since the beginning of the week. Now hero gets a bonus payment at work. How will she spend the money?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-february-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名25岁的普通工薪族。他有一个女朋友，但自本周初以来他们没有花太多时间在一起。现在英雄在工作中获得奖金。她要怎么花这笔钱呢？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/06/vn-of-month-february-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
